name: Dead tree
description: A bare dead snag about 5 m high: a leaning grey trunk stripped of most of its bark, with flared roots and the last dark bark at its foot, long cracks in the silvered wood, a jagged splintered top, two crooked bare limbs with forked twigs, snapped limb stubs, woodpecker holes and a few shelf fungi.

provenance.prompt: A bare dead snag with broken limbs, about 2 × 2 × 5 m.
